name: liendeadline
description: Jurisdiction-specific supplier notice and mechanics lien baselines with live discovery for the exact project scope. Calculations require a customer API key and use plan allowance; statute-cited guides for all 50 states and DC remain public.

interface.longDescription: A lien deadline playbook for US construction material suppliers. The agent discovers current support for the exact project scope, asks the jurisdiction-specific questions, and reports verified dates with statutes, warnings and review flags. Supplier discovery and calculations require a dedicated customer API key; completed calculations consume API plan allowance. Lien guides for all 50 states and DC remain public. It sends no notices and files no liens. Not legal advice.
